name: Hof University
overview:
Hof University is located in Hof, Bavaria, Germany.

Hof is located not far from the city of Nuremberg and the border of the Czech Republic.

By car, Berlin is 3h30 from Hof.

The University has two campuses: Hof and Münchberg.

Hof University is known for its personalized and intensive monitoring during studies.

The International Office, Housing Office, Student Counseling, and Career Service services support students on their arrival and during their studies.

For the travel advice issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Germany, click here.
administrative:
Application Dossier


Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application.

All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.

Visa

  • For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).
  • For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.
Students in France can use this website:
https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


Insurance

For European Students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual.

This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe.

  • To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure
  • It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks
  • You can also download it online
For more information:
https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For Non-European Students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay.

Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

Ariane Registration (French Citizens Only)

Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html

courses:
Number of credits to be earned per year: 60 ECTS

Number of credits to be earned per semester: 30 ECTS

Semester dates are as follows:

  • From mid-September to the end of February of the following year
  • From mid-March to the end of August
The academic calendar can be found here:
https://www.hof-university.com/welcome/academic-calendar.html


Courses and Program Structure

Classes are taught in English and will be taught at the Hof-Department of Computer Science campus.

You have the opportunity to follow projects at the Institute of Information Systems.

You have to take mainly Computer Science classes, which are based on numerous projects.

You can also take some classes in the Business and Economics Department or in the Engineer one such as Project Management.

To get an idea of the courses offered at Hof University, click on this link.


Attendance and Course Availability

We remind you that attendance is compulsory, and absenteeism may result in expulsion from the university.

The list of courses is given for information only.

It can change from one year to the next.

If a course is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.


EIP: Any tech4 abroad involves an EIP!

Take advantage of the free slots that you will have to advance them.
cost:
Estimated Budget 2025-2026

Plan a budget of EUR 735 per month for the following expenses:

  • Accommodation: 347€ (water, electricity and wifi are included with the rent. You need to give a deposit of 320€)
  • Audiovisual tax: 210 € during your stay (18€ per month, per accommodation)
  • Food (approx EUR 150€/month, depending of where do you buy it (ALDI and LIDL cheaper, EDEKA and REWE more expensive)
  • Recreation (100€, just depends of the month, maybe I travel more or not)
  • Municipal swimming pool: 35h card for 55 €
  • Personal expenses such as clothing, toiletries (approx. EUR 50)
  • University fees (administrative): EUR 130 per semester
  • (allowing a discount for the university restaurant fare and train tickets to Münchberg)
  • Free bus transportation on presentation of the HoF student card
  • Deutschland ticket: 33,17€/month, really useful if you want to travel around GermanyPlan a larger budget to cover small unexpected expenses.

For each semester, you need to pay a fee up to $100 to register for a semester, get a student card, go to the cafeteria, and take the bus within the city.
